thread:
sophie: Following the postmortem, we need owners + short timelines for the vendor auth + model-registry outage. Focus: mitigation, verification, recurrence detection.

raj: I'll own auth mitigations (sticky tokens + rolling reissue). Spike behind FF, 48h canary.

maria: I'll own model-registry resiliency: durable buffer, DLQ after 5 retries, idempotency keys, S3 backstop. PR target in 10 days.

jordan: I'll run routing fallback tests and reserve warm pool capacity in a secondary region. Schedule stage dry-run next week.

elaine: I'll track actions in the incident tracker and add clear acceptance criteria before closing. Propose fortnightly owner sync.

ops-bot: Created INC-5120 (raj) and INC-5121 (maria). Weekly ping enabled.

sophie: Acceptance criteria to add to tracker: auth canary 5xx <= 0.1% over 48h; webhook delivery >=99.9% under 95th replay; routing test <1% error delta.

raj: Spike checklist: staging FF, 3% canary, kill-switch on auth_5xx +0.3%. Demo by +4d.

maria: I'll add synthetic webhook replays to CI to validate dedupe counts and DLQ rate.

elaine: Recurrence rule: label "recurring-pattern" if same vendor outage occurs 3x in 90 days; escalate to contracts and execs. Auto-assign to oncall after 72h if owner unavailable.

sophie: Good. Action summary: INC-5120 (raj) auth spike + rollout; INC-5121 (maria) registry buffer + tests. Reconvene in 14 days for status. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync in 14 days (thread pinned).
